name: ZARP Stablecoin
oneLiner: ZARP is a centralized South African Rand stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 against ZAR cash reserves held in treasury at Old Mutual Wealth.
collateral: South African rand cash reserves held 1:1 in a treasury managed by Old Mutual Wealth, independently audited by Kempen Audit
pegMechanism: Mint/burn 1:1 with ZAR through ZARP Stablecoin (Pty) Ltd issuing partners; reserves may not be used for any purpose other than redemption

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: ZARP has multiple tracked deployments and candidate evidence points to Across. Without stronger issuer-native bridge controls resolved, external liquidity/intent routing is the material bridge route.

mintAuthority.summary: ZARP exposes AccessControl MINTER_ROLE minting. Enumerated via RoleGranted/RoleRevoked events and confirmed via hasRole: MINTER_ROLE = 0x37b1af (EOA), DEFAULT_ADMIN = 0xf50064 (EOA), UPGRADER_ROLE currently held by no one (all grants revoked). Consistent across Ethereum, Base, Polygon. Solana mintAuthority = system-owned wallet (EOA-equivalent), same address on the current Solana mint.

controls.label: ZARP MINTER_ROLE holder (Ethereum/Base/Polygon)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295023: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x37b1af...) = true; eth_getCode = 0x (EOA). RoleGranted events confirmed this address received MINTER_ROLE; no corresponding RoleRevoked. hasRole confirmed true on Base and Polygon at same address.

controls.label: ZARP DEFAULT_ADMIN (Ethereum/Base/Polygon)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295023: hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xf50064...) = true; eth_getCode = 0x (EOA). RoleGranted event at genesis plus transfer confirmed. hasRole also true on Base and Polygon.

controls.label: ZARP Solana mint authority (both mints)
controls.evidence: Solana getAccountInfo on both ZARP SPL mints (dngKhBQ... and 8v8aBHR...) returned mintAuthority = 797qLH2ZBvMrroZwxsLiWxgvDeLfUeJaHL1xWjfC7J4j. Account owner_program = 11111111111111111111111111111111 (System Program) = EOA-equivalent wallet, not a program.

review.evidence: Role enumeration via Blockscout RoleGranted/RoleRevoked events plus hasRole confirmation at block 25295023. MINTER_ROLE = one EOA (0x37b1af), DEFAULT_ADMIN = one EOA (0xf50064), UPGRADER_ROLE = nobody currently (prior holder 0xfa4eb9 had all roles revoked). Same MINTER and ADMIN confirmed on Base and Polygon. Solana both SPL mints share one system-wallet mintAuthority. All addressable controls confirmed.

reserves.name: ZAR treasury at Old Mutual Wealth (Kempen audited)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: ZARP Stablecoin (Pty) Ltd.; Old Mutual Wealth

reserveReview.rationale: ZARP's documentation states that each token represents one rand supported by a treasury of actual rand currency equivalents managed by Old Mutual Wealth. The existing 100% treasury envelope is retained, with the current Kempen agreed-upon-procedures report kept as the assurance source rather than decomposing undisclosed bank or cash-equivalent balances.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: ZARP treasury and Kempen reserve-assurance disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reserve is identified as rand currency equivalents, but the reviewed sources do not provide a current bank-account or cash-equivalent category split, provider shares, or legal segregation terms.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: ZARP identifies Old Mutual Wealth as treasury manager and Kempen as assurance provider, but the reviewed materials do not establish the reserve account structure, statutory segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation safeguards.
